## Bio

Sean an MS student in Biostatistics at Columbia University. He previously studied Statistics and Mathematics at Virginia Tech. His research interest is in disease forecasting using Bayesian methods.

Sean is actively developing and maintaining [`bayesTPC`](https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210X.70004), an interface to easily fit Bayesian thermal performance curves in R. Outside of school, he enjoys rock climbing, listening to and making music, and playing chess.
